on_window_2us_to_4us.definition: raw sample min/max inside the high plateau, no smoothing, no discarded samples

first_cross_90pct_of_on_median.definition: first interpolated time at which Iout crosses 0.9 x median(Iout in 2us..4us). This is NOT a 'settled and stayed inside a band' criterion; the VCAS 100 ns rising edge is still in progress at that instant.

transient.band_entry_definition: first sample time after which Iout never leaves median*(1+/-pct) within 1.0us..4.05us; None means it never settles in that window

ringing.source: course_tran_en.log (reported from the original run, not re-run in R2)
ringing.meaning: trapezoidal-integration warning on Xdut.Mcas:int_s; a numerical-method notice, NOT a hardware quality or SOA sign-off
